title: What cameras teach us about paying attention
summary: The frame changes what you notice, even after you put the camera down.
body:
A camera makes attention visible. The picture shows what you chose to keep, but it also hints at everything you let fall outside the frame.

## Looking is a practice

Over time, the technical decisions get quieter. What remains is the habit of noticing.
